notes.title: Version 1.3.7
notes.notes: Fixed the issue preventing some players from matchmaking with friends with an "Invalid Code", even when the code was correct.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.5
notes.notes:
THIS JUST IN

We’ve put out an emergency patch to resolve the issues caused by version 1.3.4. The problems regarding click-to-fire should now be resolved. And the online multiplayer issues should be improved. We’re working hard to return the game to it’s normal state and beyond!

Thank you for bringing these bugs to our attention so quickly, new and battle-hardened naval officers both! We really do appreciate it, and we thank you for your patience.

Stand by for further updates!

Changelog:
- Fixed the Invalid Code issue
- Improved multiplayer stability
- Click-to-fire issue resolved.
